ValidationRule.description:
If the Parent's Type is not Local Authority then require the Local Authority lookup to be populated
https://1218globaluk.eu.teamwork.com/app/tasks/36021971
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_System_Automation), OR( CONTAINS(Brand_Formula__c, "Teaching"), CONTAINS(Brand_Formula__c, "Health & Social Care") ), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Type, "Local Authority")), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Parent.Type, "Local Authority")), ISBLANK(Local_Authority__c ) )
